Patna Medical
College & Hospital
(Establishment and
Committed
Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹1,014.50
lakh was the net effect of
increase of ₹1,047.00
lakh and decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹32.50 lakh. Increase was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
medical reimbursement,
rent paid and tax,
scholarships, subsistence
allowance, maintenance
and repair and
commercial, art and
technical services.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
